description: Frames DashboardServer.onOpen sends a fresh client, in order, captured from a session with a drivetrain, a scene-backed camera and a camera stream. sim/config, sim/scene, sim/score, sim/scenarios, camera/stream and sim/camera are each conditional on the session having the thing they describe; sim/pose and device/state follow from the running ticker, not from onOpen, and may arrive before the greeting if a tick lands first.
